name: Iskuplenie
source:
This mod tells a unique story. Semyon ends up at the camp, but not in the usual way. However, he is not alone. Who is this stranger, and why is he so eager to kill him? Or is it not our protagonist he is after...

Will Semyon be able to awaken?

The choice is yours: how will it all end? Maybe he is actually a friend...
